# T0.16 — does a clean two-file layout (the benchmark's file holds only the loop's function) change anything but the harness?

*Generated by `agent/tools/campaign.py reports` from `results/campaign.json` and the experiment record (`agent/THESIS_EXPERIMENTS.md`). Edit those, then regenerate — not this file.*

**Status:** pre-flight

## The question

The author, 4 Oct: the file a model reads must be an ordinary code file — no note, no measurement code. Layout tested: the loop's function alone in the benchmark's file, `main` with the repetition loop and `pb_mix` in a second file no model can change, data and digest outside the package as in v4. Per `tsvc_b1` loop: identical output; DiscoPoP's view of the loop under study (candidates, Do-All set, blockers, the order statement) as in v4; the runner end to end with no model.

## Result in one paragraph

Server, two draws (42 loops, no model): output identical 42 of 42; DiscoPoP's view of the loop under study the same in both draws on 37; kept differences: s151 (by construction), s481 (v4 reports the REPETITION loop Do-All, v5 blocks it) and s482 (v4 blocks the loop on a RAW only the repetitions carry, v5 reports it Do-All); s244's blocker changes with the draw in both layouts. The order statement under prompt version 4 is the same in both layouts for all 42, and right on all 254 profiles replayed (86 Mac, 168 server) against the truth written down per loop; version 3 is wrong on 9, 6 and 13 of them. The sequential original is within 4 % for 37 loops; 20-26 % slower in v5 on s243, s244, s482 and 18 % faster on s292 (a separately compiled function: with link-time optimisation the difference is gone). Two draws of one layout agree on every WAR/WAW when each dependence is read by its own type; the old reading differed on 23 of 84 — T0.15's "draw noise" was the parser.
